DeepSeek demonstrated that competitive AI could be built far more cheaply, which threatened the revenue projections for chip makers like NVIDIA and the investment rationale for data center buildouts by Microsoft, Google, and Amazon.
### Who is Liang Wenfeng?
Liang Wenfeng is the founder of DeepSeek and co-founder of High-Flyer Capital, one of China’s largest quantitative hedge funds. He has an academic background in AI and has used High-Flyer’s substantial capital to fund DeepSeek’s research. He is low-profile by tech founder standards — few interviews, no major conference appearances — which makes DeepSeek’s rapid ascent even more striking.

Established in 1897 by Hangzhou's mayor, Lin Qi, Qiushi Academy was the major predecessor to the university.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhejiang_University#cite_note-zju-history-10) The educational reforms of 1902 and 1904 in China led to the academy being renamed Chekiang University in 1902,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhejiang_University#cite_note-21) and subsequently Chekiang Higher Institute in 1903.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhejiang_University#cite_note-22) Elmer L.
